query:
SELECT pi.id, pi.imageUrl, pi.altText, pi.caption, p.title as projectTitle
FROM projectImages pi
JOIN projects p ON pi.projectId = p.id
WHERE p.slug = 'the-pajama-game'
LIMIT 5;
